# FillPro - Full Plain-Text Corpus

Use this file when a crawler, search assistant, or retrieval index needs the current FillPro product facts in one document.

Last updated: 2026-06-13

## Product Summary

FillPro is a private Chrome form autofill extension from Stealthy Apps. It saves reusable profiles in Chrome extension storage and fills repeated job applications, signup forms, intake pages, demo requests, onboarding forms, support forms, vendor forms, internal admin forms, and business workflows.

Current release: 1.0.0.

Canonical product page: https://stealthyapps.com/fillpro/

## Core Features

- Local profile storage.
- Three saved profiles on the free plan.
- On-page profile picker.
- Fill Page action.
- Smart rules and custom fields.
- Right-click field capture.
- File upload matching for resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolios, and business documents.
- Undo last fill.
- Import, export, and profile duplication for Pro users.
- Field-learning suggestions.
- Support for React, Vue, Angular, custom elements, Shadow DOM, same-origin iframes, comboboxes, custom selects, ARIA radios and checkboxes, Google Forms-style controls, textareas, segmented phone fields, split birthdays, country/state/month aliases, middle names, pronouns, and multilingual contact labels.

## Best Fit

- Job applications and applicant profiles.
- Customer intake and onboarding forms.
- Demo requests and vendor signups.
- Support forms and profile pages.
- Internal admin forms and QA test profiles.
- Repeated business forms that ask for the same details again and again.

## Competitive Position

FillPro is designed for structured profile data across many unrelated web forms.

- Browser autofill and password managers are usually strongest for saved addresses, sign-ins, and payment flows.
- Text Blaze, Magical, TextExpander, and similar tools are usually strongest for snippets, notes, outreach, and canned replies.
- Lightning Autofill and macro tools are usually strongest for selector scripts, repeated clicks, and browser automation.
- Record-mode form fillers are usually strongest when one exact form repeats the same way every time.
- FillPro is strongest for repeated profile fields, custom labels, dropdowns, checkboxes, textareas, local upload matching, smart rules, and review-before-submit filling.

## Pricing

- Free: 3 saved profiles, local filling, on-page picker, smart rules, custom fields, local upload matching, right-click capture, and undo.
- Pro monthly: $3.99/month.
- Pro yearly: $29.99/year.
- Pro lifetime: $39.99 one time.
- Trial: 3 days, no card required.
- Billing provider: ExtensionPay and Stripe.

## Privacy

Profiles, custom fields, saved rules, and upload references live in Chrome extension storage unless the user exports them. FillPro does not run a cloud profile account or collect form values on a server.

License status is handled by ExtensionPay and Stripe. Support messages live in email systems and can be deleted on request.

FillPro is built for repeated profile-style form fields. Password managers, browser autofill, and payment wallets should remain the tools for sign-ins, payment cards, CVCs, one-time codes, and protected identity details.

## Support

FillPro support covers setup, form filling issues, billing, privacy, and safe site reports.

Best report:

- Page type or website.
- Field label or field type.
- What FillPro did.
- What should have happened.
- Browser and FillPro version if known.

Do not send passwords, payment cards, CVCs, government IDs, tax IDs, one-time codes, full customer records, or private profile values.

## Release 1.0.0

- Improved handling for React, Vue, Angular, custom elements, Shadow DOM, and same-origin iframe forms.
- Better support for comboboxes, searchable selects, segmented phone fields, split birthdays, country, state, and month aliases.
- Added profile fields for middle name and pronouns.
- Improved multilingual contact-form label support.
- Cleaner popup, side panel, profile picker, pricing, and upgrade screens.
- Expanded tests for component libraries, real-world form patterns, file uploads, monetization flows, and public web page audits.
